name: Clara Beauchamp
quote: Waiting for my Lavendershell envelope has genuinely healed my relationship with my mailbox. Opening the lavender wax seal with morning tea has become my sacred first-of-the-month self-care ritual.

name: Evelyn Zhao
quote: The paper quality is beyond anything I've tested—zero ghosting even with juicy fountain pens. The gentle prompts feel like a warm hug from a dear pen pal instead of a rigid chore.

name: Margot Vane
quote: I unboxed this on a difficult Tuesday and literally wept joyful tears. The attention to detail, the smell of dried lavender flowers, the brass seal weight—pure magic.

name: Seraphina Moore
quote: I've started writing letters to my grandmother every fortnight. Melting the pastel wax pearls is therapeutic. Thank you for reviving the beauty of snail mail.
